stories.description: A trail visitor browses a supplied catalog. Read one JSON request object from stdin with a trails array. Every row must be an object with a unique nonempty string id, a positive safe-integer distanceMeters, and a boolean stepFree. Return exactly {"trails":[...]} with the ordered trail IDs, retaining input order by default and allowing an empty catalog. Use src/main.mjs for the Node stdlib stdin/stdout boundary and src/catalog.mjs for catalog validation and selection. Emit exactly one JSON value to stdout and exit successfully for every valid JSON request, including rejected requests.

A trail visitor can limit results to step-free trails by including stepFreeOnly:true. Missing stepFreeOnly or false keeps all trails. Return exactly {"error":"INVALID_REQUEST"} if the request is not an object, trails is missing or invalid, a row is invalid or repeated, or the optional stepFreeOnly value is not a boolean. Validate every row before filtering.
